scientificAssessment.reasoning: Matsushita’s primary abstract supports selection of pre-existing antigen-distinct clones under T-cell pressure in a defined mouse model. The new example is explicitly invented: both arms begin 80 A/20 B; later control is 160/40 and pressure is 10/40. Counts, denominators and shares are consistent, with B present initially and 40/50 equal to 80 percent. This shows relative enrichment through a different A outcome, without T-cell-created mutation or a mandatory phase calendar. Recognition controls and alternative causes remain stated.
